thread:
sam.design: Quick heads-up — on the private setup wizard I hit a weird focus trap on the hostname field when tabbing forward from the CIDR input. The focus jumps back and I have to click to continue. :eyes: elaine.prod: Ugh. Good catch. Was this in Chrome? Any console errors? naveen.platform: Chrome 115 on macOS here. No console errors. I can repro but only if there’s a validation state shown (red helper text). If helper text visible, tab target seems to be rerendered. kevin.devex: Might be the inline validation replacing the input node which loses focus. We did a small refactor last week that changed keying — could be that. sam.design: Yeah it looks like we set key to the error message. Quick screenshot: — repro steps: 1) enter bad CIDR, 2) tab to hostname, 3) hit tab again, focus returns to hostname input and moves nowhere. elaine.prod: Aside from the focus trap, the hostname label is confusing — it says “Hostname (optional)” but the helper text discusses “instance name” elsewhere. We should pick one term. Product decision? kevin.devex: Prefer “Instance name” in UI copy, it’s more descriptive for on-prem. We can alias in KB: "Hostname (Instance name)" for backwards compatibility. naveen.platform: Agree on naming. Also accessibility nit: screenreader reads "Hostname, input" but no description about accepted characters. We should add aria-describedby pointing to the helper. Example: ```
Letters, numbers, hyphens. No spaces.
``` kevin.devex: That snippet is helpful. Also add role=\"status\" for live validation messages so SR users hear immediate errors. sam.design: For copy: proposed text for helper — "Instance name (optional). Use letters, numbers, and hyphens. This value identifies your instance in logs and must be unique in your network." Thoughts? elaine.prod: Shorten to: "Instance name (optional). Letters, numbers, and hyphens only — used for logs and debugging." Keep tone concise. naveen.platform: Sounds good. I’ll change the HTML keying so the input node is stable (use a consistent key based on field id, not error state). That should fix the tabbing. elaine.prod: Can we also ensure the focus ring is visible on high-contrast themes? A11y test caught low contrast on focus outline last pass. kevin.devex: I’ll add a small CSS tweak: `outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px;` only for high-contrast modes. sam.design: One more thing — when CIDR validation fails we show a long technical message. Can we surface the minimal error inline and link to an expandable KB for details? Users in the setup flow just need a quick hint. elaine.prod: Yes — inline: "Invalid CIDR — expected format x.x.x.x/y" and a "More info" link that opens an in-place panel with examples. aveen.platform: Implementation plan: 1) stabilize input keys, 2) add aria-describedby and role=status, 3) swap label to "Instance name", 4) update helper copy and add compact inline error + More info panel. I’ll submit a PR today. kevin.devex: I’ll prepare the small CSS and the aria snippet in a follow-up PR. sam.design: I’ll update FigJam with the copy change and new keyboard flow notes. elaine.prod: Thanks team. Can we track as a small UX ticket and mark priority P2? Sam, can you file the ticket with the repro steps + screenshot? sam.design: Yup — filing now and will link PRs once ready. :thumbsup: deploy-bot: New ticket created: #INT-5427 \"Instance name focus trap & copy polish in Private setup wizard\" — assignees: naveen.platform, kevin.devex, sam.design. kevin.devex: Great, I’ll add acceptance criteria for a11y test pass. elaine.prod: Cool. Move to backlog->in progress when PR is up. Thanks!
